mapper.sql: event_subject_id AS eventSubjectId, velocity_event_id AS velocityEventId, subject_type AS subjectType, subject_key AS subjectKey, event_code AS eventCode, occurred_time AS occurredTime, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_velocity_event_subject(event_subject_id, velocity_event_id, subject_type, subject_key, event_code, occurred_time, create_time) VALUES(#{row.eventSubjectId}, #{row.velocityEventId}, #{row.subjectType}, #{row.subjectKey}, #{row.eventCode}, #{row.occurredTime}, #{row.createTime})

INSERT INTO t_velocity_event_subject(event_subject_id, velocity_event_id, subject_type, subject_key, event_code, occurred_time, create_time) VALUES (#{row.eventSubjectId}, #{row.velocityEventId}, #{row.subjectType}, #{row.subjectKey}, #{row.eventCode}, #{row.occurredTime}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_velocity_event_subject WHERE subject_type = #{subjectType} AND subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND event_code = #{eventCode} AND occurred_time >= #{from} AND occurred_time < #{to}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.amount), 0) FROM t_velocity_event_subject s JOIN t_velocity_event e ON e.velocity_event_id = s.velocity_event_id WHERE s.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND s.subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND s.event_code = #{eventCode} AND s.occurred_time >= #{from} AND s.occurred_time < #{to} AND e.currency = #{currency}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.subject_key) FROM t_velocity_event_subject s JOIN t_velocity_event_subject d ON d.velocity_event_id = s.velocity_event_id AND d.subject_type = #{distinctType} WHERE s.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND s.subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND s.event_code = #{eventCode} AND s.occurred_time >= #{from} AND s.occurred_time < #{to}

SELECT e.velocity_event_id AS velocityEventId, e.event_code AS eventCode, e.source_type AS sourceType, e.source_id AS sourceId, e.source_version AS sourceVersion, e.occurred_time AS occurredTime, e.amount, e.currency, e.event_hash AS eventHash, e.create_time AS createTime FROM t_velocity_event_subject s JOIN t_velocity_event e ON e.velocity_event_id = s.velocity_event_id WHERE s.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND s.subject_key = #{subjectKey} AND s.event_code = #{eventCode} AND s.occurred_time >= #{from} AND s.occurred_time < #{to} ORDER BY s.occurred_time DESC, s.velocity_event_id DESC LIMIT 1
